headlines.title: Bank of America (BAC) Renews Long Term Card Tie Up With a Travel Partner
headlines.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) and Allegiant Travel Company extended their co-branded credit card partnership under a new long-term agreement. The renewed pact keeps Allegiant’s Allways Rewards credit card on the Bank of America platform with continued loyalty program integration. The extension supports Bank of America’s focus on recurring non-interest income streams tied to travel and everyday spending.

headlines.title: BankAmeriDeals: How Bank of America customers can stack extra cash back on everyday buys
headlines.summary: Bank of America’s BankAmeriDeals program offers eligible customers the opportunity to earn additional cash-back rewards at popular merchants and retailers.

headlines.title: Quants Unwind Bond Shorts as Stock Swoon Drives Traders to Safety
headlines.summary: Trend-chasing quant funds are trimming their long-held short positions in US Treasuries, fueling a bond rally as an equity selloff revives haven demand for government debt.

headlines.title: Is Bank of America's Attractive Valuation Enough to Buy the Stock?
headlines.summary: BAC's discounted valuation, strong revenue growth and AI investments offer upside potential, but earnings concerns suggest caution before buying.

headlines.title: JPMorgan and Bank of America Just Sold Off. One Looks Better for Retirees
headlines.summary: One bank is cheaper and pays more today. The other has a thicker safety cushion and a dividend history that bounced back years sooner. For retirees, the real question is which advantage matters when the next downturn arrives.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
